channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Palo Alto Networks

item.title: Patch: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Authentication Bypass
item.description:
Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 12.1.4-h6, 11.2.4-h17, 11.1.4-h33

First step: Update Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS to the fixed version for your release line (for example 12.1.4-h6, 11.2.4-h17 or 11.1.4-h33).

Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-0257
